model_name: Session and DDoS Behavioral Detection Rules

containment_recommendations: Require the user to reauthenticate with MFA.
Invalidate active authentication tokens where supported.
Review sensitive actions performed during the anomalous session window.
Review recent authentication activity for additional suspicious access.
Temporarily restrict the account if additional compromise indicators are identified.
Apply or tighten rate limiting for the affected service or endpoint.
Use web application firewall or reverse-proxy controls to challenge or restrict abusive traffic.
Coordinate with network or hosting providers for upstream filtering if service impact continues.
Preserve relevant network, web, and application logs for investigation.
Monitor service health and response latency during containment.
Avoid broad blocking decisions until legitimate traffic impact has been evaluated.
